outcomeAddedDuringS11B.name: PHASE_CONTROL_INSUFFICIENT
outcomeAddedDuringS11B.reason: the first synthetic run showed the declared shiftTolerance of 3 does not scale with the horizon: known time-driven fields (timer, frameCounter) are rejected at 12 frames and falsely CONFIRMED from 48 frames upward, so a confirmation at a long horizon is not interpretable as causal. Awarding RECOVERED_BY_DURATION there would present an instrument artefact as a recovered causal link - the mirror image of presenting an instrument limit as an absent event.
outcomeAddedDuringS11B.declaredRule: where a control field known to be time-driven is confirmed at a horizon, that horizon is marked PHASE_CONTROL_INSUFFICIENT and no recovery is claimed from it
outcomeAddedDuringS11B.shiftToleranceUnchanged: the pre-registered value 3 is NOT altered; a horizon-scaled tolerance is a separately declared comparison

rules: a limit of the observing instrument is never the absence of a game event
an instrument artefact is never a recovered causal link
the raw diff is recorded separately and never promoted to causal evidence
RECOVERED_BY_CADENCE requires a duration-matched continuous control
more observed RAM changes is not success
